verdict.rationale: Sumsub provides a documented Sandbox mode that lets users test integrations (app tokens, webhooks, WebSDK) without touching production data, explicitly for pre-go-live testing. This directly matches the story for both regular and AI-native (MCP-based) integrations since the MCP server operates under the same account/role permissions. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that MCP-driven agent actions can be scoped to sandbox mode specifically, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
